name: Erlebnisberg Achensee
kurzbeschreibung: The Rofan adventure mountain above Lake Achensee offers thrilling sky glider flights, panoramic trails, via ferratas, and scenic lake views.
preis: Cable car round trip adults €30.50, children €18.50; flight attractions from €18.00
oeffnungszeiten: Late April to early Nov daily 08:30–17:00 (high summer from 08:00); winter operations mid-Dec to late March
beschreibung:
Overview

The Rofan Adventure Mountain (Erlebnisberg Rofan) soaring above Maurach at Lake Achensee is renowned as one of the most exhilarating panoramic mountains in the Tyrolean lowlands. The modern Rofan cable car whisks mountain lovers in just minutes from the valley station beside the shores of Lake Achensee up to over 1,840 meters altitude into the striking limestone realm of the Rofan range. At the top, a sweeping 360-degree vista opens across the fjord-like blue waters of Lake Achensee, the lower Inn Valley, and the glaciated peaks of the Zillertal and Karwendel Alps. The adventure mountain seamlessly combines alpine nature with signature thrills: from the Airrofan Skyglider launching passengers at 80 km/h down a steel cable to the Eagle's Nest (Adlerhorst) viewing platform on the Gschöllkopf summit.

Route & Requirements

On the high Rofan plateau, outdoor enthusiasts discover a wide range of trails spanning leisurely family walks to demanding alpine via ferratas. From the mountain station, a level and stroller-accessible path leads to welcoming mountain inns like the Erfurter Hütte and Mauritzalm. The rewarding ascent to the Gschöllkopf summit (2,039 m) and its scenic Adlerhorst platform takes about 45 minutes along well-constructed paths. For experienced scramblers, the celebrated Achensee 5-Peaks Via Ferrata traverses five prominent limestone crests. High-alpine routes require sturdy ankle-high hiking boots with vibram soles, weather-protective layers, and surefootedness.

Visit & Arrival

The valley station of the Rofanseilbahn is situated right in Maurach on Lake Achensee with excellent transit connections. By rail, travel to Jenbach station and connect directly with regional bus lines or the nostalgic Achensee steam cogwheel railway into Maurach. Motorists reach Maurach toll-free via the Achen Valley from Tegernsee/Bad Tölz or via the Inntal autobahn (A12, exit Wiesing/Achensee). Free parking is provided at the valley terminal for cable car ticket holders.

Tips

For an unforgettable adrenaline rush, take flight on the Airrofan Skyglider, soaring down the mountainside like an eagle. Relax on the sun terrace of the Erfurter Hütte savoring authentic Tyrolean cheese dumplings (Kaspressknödel) with direct lake views. Pair your mountain trip with an Achensee boat cruise or a swim at the Maurach lakeside beach.
